result.description: Compact LED portable projector designed for casual home cinema and travel presentations. Features 1080p native input support, 300 ANSI lumen output, dual HDMI and USB-C connectivity, built-in stereo speakers, and automatic keystone correction. Suitable for tabletop or ceiling projection in dim environments.
